name: Wand over Fist
summary: At Refuge Pointe, Skuerto has found where Trelane's first item went. Kor'gresh holds Trelane's Wand of Invocation in Boulderfist Hall, and Skuerto wants it back.

sections.title: The Ogre and the Wand
sections.body: After your work for Apprentice Kryten, Skuerto has traced Trelane's first item to Kor'gresh. The ogre holds the wand in Boulderfist Hall and uses blasts of ice to keep his kin in line. Skuerto fears Kor'gresh is close to discovering all its powers. Boulderfist Hall lies south of Refuge Pointe, then east of Thandol Span.

sections.title: Skuerto's List
sections.body: When you return, Skuerto counts the wand as one item found. Three more remain on his list, and all three are in Stromgarde.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Wand over Fist?
aliases: where to get wand over fist
faq.answer: At Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands, Skuerto asks you to recover the wand.
Kor'gresh is in Boulderfist Hall, south of Refuge Pointe and then east of Thandol Span.

faq.q: What item needs to be recovered?
faq.answer: Trelane's Wand of Invocation is the first of Trelane's items to be recovered. Kor'gresh has used it to throw blasts of ice at his kin.

faq.q: What prerequisites are needed for this quest?
aliases: previous quest to wand over fist
faq.answer: You reach this work after Worth Its Weight in Gold, the work you did for Apprentice Kryten.
